107738.context: So today I want to talk about moral superiority, purity test, and how communities turn loyalty into a weapon. Because the goal should not be to feel better than most people. The goal should be to become better for people. Let's begin by defining moral superiority, or as I like to call it, moral supremism. Moral superiority is the belief, posture, or performance that says my moral position makes me better than you. It's not the same thing as having strong values. It's not the same thing as believing something is right or wrong.
107738.creator: darante-lamar
107738.title: Why Good People Become Cruel
